statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-53488 (GHSA-xhf5-7wjv-pqxp, GO-2026-5758): containerd's CRI plugin copied labels from an image config (the Dockerfile LABEL instruction) onto the container without validation, so an image could set labels that containerd or a plugin acts on, which can lead to running a command on the host. It is fixed in containerd 1.7.33, 2.0.10, 2.1.9, 2.2.5 and 2.3.2; on the release/2.2 branch, from which 2.2.5 is cut, the fix is commit b6072a4 (Do not propagate reserved labels from image configs), which changes the CRI plugin's label handling, the client package's WithImageConfigLabels option and the pkg/labels validation: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-xhf5-7wjv-pqxp, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/b6072a49f8d3f6efc5ac9895efbb1852b16a2602, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5758. Read the Go build information and the function table of every Go program in every build-dev package published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository: 89 builds, 2.6.4-r0 through the current 2.29.1-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64 except 2.6.4-r0, which is published for aarch64 only, every download checked against the index checksum. Each package holds one file, the Go program /usr/bin/build. Version 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in each index, every entry with the same source commit and installed size as 2.19.1-r0; the copy the repository serves was read. The build information of /usr/bin/build lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 (2.2.0 through 2.3.7 across the builds), but the vulnerable code was not linked in. In every build, the only containerd packages in the function table are the registry resolver (core/remotes/docker with its auth and errors packages), pkg/reference, pkg/identifiers, internal/lazyregexp and version, and no function table contains any of containerd's CRI plugin code (internal/cri, pkg/cri or plugins/cri), its client package (github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/client, which holds WithImageConfigLabels) or its label validation package (pkg/labels).

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53488: the containerd CRI plugin passes image-config labels through to the restart-monitor binary:// logger, which can lead to host command execution from an image pull; github.com/containerd/containerd 1.7.0 to 1.7.32 is affected (fixed in 1.7.33), and containerd/v2 is fixed in 2.0.10, 2.1.9, 2.2.5 and 2.3.2 (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-xhf5-7wjv-pqxp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5758). The Go build information of /usr/bin/trivy in each of the 37 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r11), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was read for this decision. Builds before 0.71.2-r0 embed github.com/containerd/containerd 1.7.29 to 1.7.32 (in some of them) and github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.3.1, which the advisory lists as affected. Builds from 0.71.2-r0 on embed github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.3.2 to 2.3.6 and no longer include github.com/containerd/containerd, which the advisory does not list as affected.
